name: Do You Remember San Diego 2024

venue.name: Private residence
venue.details: Details will be shared with registered competitors closer to the competition date

information:
**Please note that this competition will not have traditional speedsolving events and not recommended for first time competitors.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoYouRememberSanDiego2024#43178-competitor-responsibilities-and-faq) tab.
​
Spectators will not be permitted to attend this competition.
​
This competition is sponsored by  [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com) and [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com):
